meta_description: Unofficial Heartopia dex tool to search fish, bugs, and birds by location, weather, and time. See what's available right now. Sell price display included.
meta_description_foods: Full list of Heartopia recipes. Check ingredients, ingredient cost, sell price, and profit.
meta_description_garden: Heartopia crop and flower dex. Growth time, seed price, crossbreeding list, and notification support.
meta_description_pet: Heartopia pet food tracker. Keep track of what you've fed your dogs and cats.
meta_description_codes: List of active Heartopia gift codes. Check rewards and expiration dates.
meta_description_events: List of ongoing and upcoming Heartopia events and gacha info.
meta_description_faq: Frequently asked questions, requests, and bug fix status for Hatopi Encyclopedia.
meta_description_achievements: A list of Heartopia achievements. Check unlock conditions and reward titles, and track your progress.
page_header_subtitle: Displays creatures based on Heartopia's current weather and time
codes_page_subtitle: Tap a code to copy it
faq_page_subtitle: Frequently asked questions, requests, and bug fix status
garden_breeding_note: Crossbreeding happens every day at 6 AM. Place two of the same color next to each other to get a higher-rarity seed.
garden_notif_desc:
Normal: background notification at harvest time
Weeding: notifications at 3 weeding points plus harvest
garden_notif_permission_text: Notification permission is required to receive background notifications
garden_notif_blocked_text:
Notifications are blocked.
Please allow notifications for this site in your device/browser settings, then press the button below.
garden_toast_still_blocked: Still blocked. Please check your settings
garden_help_tabs_body: Use the "Crops" and "Flowers" tabs at the top to switch views. You can see growth time, seed price, and sell price for each.
garden_help_detail_body: Tap a card to see the sell price for each rarity (1–5 stars). For flowers, you'll also see the list of colors you can breed.
garden_help_check_body: Use the circle button in the top-right of a card to track completion, and the one in the bottom-right (shown only where applicable) to track Master certification.
garden_help_breeding_body: The flower detail screen shows the colors that flower can produce and example breeding combinations. Breeding happens every day at 6:00. Planting 2 flowers of the same color next to each other produces a seed one rarity tier higher. Combination examples only show colors that flower can actually produce.
garden_help_notif_body:
You can register notifications from a crop's detail screen.
Normal Mode: one notification at harvest time
Weeding Mode: 3 weeding alerts plus a harvest notification
Crops with notifications registered show a bell icon, and a timer and progress bar appear on the card.
garden_help_notice_body:
Harvest notifications only work if the site is added to your home screen and notification permission is granted.
Notifications may be off by up to about 1 minute. In Weeding Mode, the 1st and 2nd alerts fire around each third of the growth time, and the 3rd fires 1–2 minutes before harvest.
If issues come up, this feature may be paused without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

help_search_body: Search by creature name or location.
help_type_body: Switch between Fish, Bugs, and Birds, plus the seasonal Sand Sculpture, Snow Sculpture, and Shell categories.
help_mode_body:
· All currently appearing
· Current weather only
· Not appearing now
help_sort_body: Sort by encyclopedia order, level, incomplete first, or uncertified first.
help_server_body: Use the server selector at the top to change the displayed time. Appearance is always calculated in Japan time (JST); only the displayed time is converted to the selected server's time zone.
help_spot_body: Shows today's spawn location for both Firefly Stones and Oak Trees. Use the calendar button to check the schedule for the next few days.
help_tasks_body: See today's weather forecast, the time until the next scheduled quest, a checklist of items that reset daily, and events or codes that are ending soon — all in one place.
help_star_body:
Tap the ○ button (top-right of card) to check.
Multi-select → bulk check is also available.
help_auth_body:
Tap the ○ button (bottom-right of card) to check.
Multi-select → bulk check is also available.
help_multi_body_1: The multi-select feature has a few steps — here's how it works:
help_multi_body_2: 1. Press Multi-select to enter multi-select mode.
help_multi_body_3: 2. Tap all the creatures you want to check.
help_multi_body_4: 3. When done tapping, press the Star-5 or Master bulk check button.
help_multi_body_5: 4. After bulk checking, press Multi-select again to exit.
help_multi_body_6: Note: Star-5 and Master cannot be checked at the same time.
help_meteor_body: Meteor showers are treated as sunny weather.
help_minimize_body: Collapse the top panel using the minimize button.
help_share_body:
Press the share button to share.
Generates a simple image of your completion status.
help_sync_body: Use the button at the top to export or import your data (completion status, settings, and more) as a file. Handy as a backup when switching devices or browsers.
help_theme_body: Use the button at the top to toggle dark mode. Supported languages: Japanese / English / 한국어 / ไทย / 简体中文 / 繁體中文.
help_contact_body:
You can contact us at the bottom of the page.
Completely anonymous submissions are available.
help_contact_note: (A Q&A page for answers is planned.)
help_notice_body:
This site saves your state when you close it.
Your previous state will be restored when you reopen it.

meta_description_build: A tool for Heartopia (Heartopia: Relaxing Farm Life) that converts an image into a 3D voxel building-material placement blueprint.
build_page_subtitle: Convert an image into a 3D voxel building blueprint
build_notice: This is a trial release. Bulk editing via range-select, build-stage playback, and link sharing are still in progress.
build_result_hint: Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom
build_new_image: Start over with a new image
build_help_1_title: ① Choose an image & building mode
build_help_1_body: Upload an image and choose "Solid (statue)", "Flat (ground)", or "Low wall (mural)". Set the width, thickness, hollowing, auto-transparent background, and color-limiting options here too (low wall mode is a single layer, so it has no thickness or hollowing option). In solid mode you can also add an optional back image. The real support-pillar material is twice as tall as it is wide/deep, so solid mode's height is auto-compensated and the 3D preview shows the same proportions it will have when actually built. The low wall panel is 4 wide and 2 tall, so low wall mode auto-compensates the other axis the same way. In low wall mode you can also choose whether width or height drives the size — set the one you pick, and the other is calculated automatically to match the image's proportions.
build_help_2_body: Drag to position and use the slider to zoom, setting the crop area for the front image.
build_help_3_body: The nearest matching material (support pillar) is assigned automatically for each color, and you can drag to rotate and zoom right there to check it. The material types and pillar counts needed are listed below.
build_help_4_body: Name your design and save it to recall it anytime from "Saved designs" below. You can also export/import it as JSON (useful for backups or moving to another device).
build_import_confirm: Add the imported designs? (existing designs will be kept)
build_crop_grid_hint: The white lines show roughly where each cell boundary will fall
build_resolution_tip: Illustrations with clear, solid-colored outlines convert best — fine facial details and soft gradients tend to be simplified away.

achievements_help_check_body: Use the button in the top-right of a card, or the button on the detail screen, to record whether you've unlocked it. This does not sync with in-game data, so please record it manually.

build_legacy_design_note: This design was saved with the previous (2D mural) version and can't be loaded.
build_help_edit_body: Select "Pen" and tap a face to add one voxel of the selected material against that face. Select "Eraser" and tap a voxel to remove it. Use "Choose material" to change what the pen places. "Undo"/"Redo" step edits back and forward.
build_progress_edit_disabled_hint: Editing is disabled while viewing a build stage. Switch back to "All" to resume editing.
build_help_progress_body: Move the "Build stage" slider to see how the structure looks built up to a given layer from the bottom (solid mode) or a given row from the top (flat mode). Editing is disabled while anything other than "All" is selected. In flat mode, the "Placement guide" can show gridlines every 4x4, 8x8, or 16x16 tiles, and picking one block shows step-by-step instructions for what to place where in it.
build_color_count_hint: The most frequently used colors are kept first. Fewer colors means a simpler look and fewer material types.
build_guide_picker_hint: Pick a block to see step-by-step instructions for what goes where in it
build_guide_empty: Nothing has been placed in this block yet
